description: Cross-language conformance inputs for the verifiable distributed shuffle and reveal-proof verification (commitment-based MVP). Each implementation (TS @cardtable/crypto-cards, Go apps/relay-go/pkg/cryptocards) consumes these inputs and produces deterministic hashes; the two outputs MUST agree byte-for-byte. Concrete expected hashes are reproduced inside each language's test as named constants and are the conformance surface — when both sides agree, those constants are locked.
conformance_assertions: commitEntropy(entropy_i, player_id_i, game_id) MUST equal hash returned by every conforming impl
combineEntropy([entropy_0, entropy_1, entropy_2]) (seat-ascending order) MUST be byte-identical across impls
buildDeckCommitment(combined, 52, 1).shuffled_deck MUST be a permutation of 0..51 byte-identical across impls
verifyRevealProof with a corrupted ordinal MUST return false
